voxelSize.note: Refined voxel size, used only by the Refine step (the first design uses a coarser voxel set by the voxel limit).

designSpace.note: How far the connector may wander from the straight path, as a fraction of the gap between the surfaces.

analysisVoxelBudget.note: Maximum voxels in the design space. Fewer = much faster.

volumeFraction.note: Share of the design space that may be filled. Left = light, right = strong.

printReady.note: Print-ready (test): printed with the flange face on the bed. Nothing grows below the bed, and every voxel must rest on voxels below it (45° overhang at most), so there are no supports and no floating islands. Method: additive manufacturing filter (Langelaar 2017).

refineAtEnd.note: Generate ends with a Refine run at the refined voxel size (slower, nicer result).

material.label: PLA
material.note: Used only for the weight and sag readout (solid, 100% infill). Printed parts are weaker across layers.

cantileverRatio.note: Self-test: the solver's cantilever tip drop divided by beam theory must fall in this range.

filterRadius.note: In voxels. Bigger = thicker, smoother members.

maxIterations.note: The design stops earlier when it stops changing.

payloadMassKg.note: Mass of the tool end and what it carries.

accelFactor.note: Multiplier for robot motion (1 = standing still).

extraForceN.note: Optional extra force at the centre of mass of the tool end.

faceExtrudeMm.note: Gap: how far a red face is pushed outward. Nothing can grow inside this zone. 0 = only the face itself.

robotOffsetMm.note: Keep-out cylinder below the tool start: plate diameter plus this offset on each side. Nothing grows inside it.

objectGrowMm.note: Gap: how far a red object is offset (grown evenly in all directions). 0 = only the object itself.

diameterAdjustMm.note: Added to the head clearance diameter of the tool start (Allen head + 0.25).

lengthAdjustMm.note: Added to the head height + 0.25 of the tool start.

voxelBudget.note: Maximum voxels in the refined grid. If it would be more, the refined voxel is made coarser automatically.

bandVoxels.note: How far (in analysis voxels) the refined design may grow around the existing material.

maxIterations.note: The refined design stops earlier when it stops changing.

stiffnessTolerance.note: The refined design may lose this share of stiffness (compared with the coarse design) in exchange for less material.

shrinkStep.note: Share of the material cap removed per shrink round.

minVolumeFraction.note: The material may not drop below this share of the coarse volume.

passes.note: Smoothing passes per click (each pass blurs the shape by about one voxel). More = rounder, but thin members get thinner. The volume is kept.
